description_en: Verify that the FG configuration is correct and meets all rules
description_zh: 检查FG配置内容是否正确，是否满足所有规则
name: CheckModelFeatureFGFeature

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can get it from the ListInstances API
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The model feature ID. You can get it from the ListModelFeatures API
parameters.help_zh: 模型特征ID，可从接口ListModelFeatures获取
parameters.name: model_feature_id

Message.example: f1[1]: these lookup_features's LookupValueFeature(key) not exist in model features

RuleCode.description_en:
The rule code for the check.

SeqSubEx—Are the sub-features of sequence features in the FG present in the model feature?

LookupKeyEx—Does the lookup key feature of query features exist in the model feature?

FGSetEx—Are all FG features present in the model feature?

ModelSetEx—Are all model feature features present in the FG?
RuleCode.description_zh:
检查规则代码。
SeqSubEx-FG序列特征的子特征是否存在于ModelFeature的特征中？
LookupKeyEx-FG查询特征的检查键值特征是否存在 ModelFeature 特征中？
FGSetEx-所有FG特征，是否存在于 ModelFeature 特征中？
ModelSetEx-所有 ModelFeature 特征，是否存在于 FG 特征中？
